assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY is the repository provisional rough polygon, not an official planning boundary.
assumptions.impact: All spatial geometry, figures, and metrics require whole-chain recalculation.
assumptions.trigger: Official or rights-cleared polygon with provenance, version, CRS, and conversion record.

assumptions.statement: The three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional placeholders based on order and approximate area.
assumptions.impact: Key-area placement and detailed design remain directional.

assumptions.statement: Approved land use, FAR, height, BCR, green ratio, setbacks, and control lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land-use shares and building prototypes are conceptual, not statutory controls.
assumptions.trigger: Approved Regulatory Detailed Planning and official design attachments.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprint, height, use, age, structure, fire safety, and lawful floor area are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No parcel or building receives a final Demolish-Renovate-Retain judgment.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, rail protection, entrances, traffic counts, curb use, and fire access are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Roads represent connection logic only; road area and engineering feasibility remain unknown.
assumptions.trigger: Official transport, rail, and safety information.

assumptions.statement: Complete heritage-protection boundaries and construction-control zones are not supplied as project GIS.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks remain low-volume, reversible concepts subject to relocation.
assumptions.trigger: Official heritage survey and professional approval.

assumptions.statement: Public access rights and management responsibilities are not confirmed for every conceptual public-space polygon.
assumptions.impact: Public-space ratio is a design allocation, not a guarantee of public access.
assumptions.trigger: Ownership, easement, operating, and safety agreements.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire, energy, water, and network capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: New Infrastructure is a dual-layer service concept, not an engineering design.

assumptions.statement: Personas and worst-time needs are hypotheses derived from the taskbook and public-interest standards, not resident survey results.
assumptions.impact: Operational baselines and outcomes remain unknown until rights-cleared participation and field measurement.
assumptions.trigger: Open, rights-cleared, de-identified participation and measurement plan.
